name: fix_flaky_tests
title: Reproduce -> Diagnose -> Fix Flaky Tests
description: Scan a test suite for flaky tests, produce a task_list.v1 of reproducers/fixes, and fix each flaky test in parallel, reporting the checks that show it is stable.

inputs.name: suite
inputs.description: Test suite or package path to scan for flakes

inputs.name: test_command
inputs.description: Test command used to reproduce flaky tests

brief.goal: Identify flaky tests in {{inputs.suite}} (using {{inputs.test_command}}), determine root causes, and emit a task_list.v1 of isolated fixes.
acceptance: Structured task_list.v1 listing each flaky test with a root-cause goal and acceptance criteria
Flake eliminated and the test passes deterministically; the repeated runs used to show this are reported in the submit summary

brief.goal: Check that the full {{inputs.suite}} suite is stable after all flake fixes (using {{inputs.test_command}}).
acceptance: The suite passes repeatedly without flakes; the runs and their outcomes are reported in the submit summary
